mapper.select: SELECT * FROM relations.ledger_family WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT family_id FROM relations.ledger_member WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT id FROM relations.sys_user WHERE id=#{userId} AND is_deleted=FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(nickname),''),'家人') FROM relations.sys_user WHERE id=#{userId} AND is_deleted=FALSE

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM relations.ledger_friend WHERE family_id=#{familyId}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM relations.ledger_book WHERE family_id=#{familyId}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM relations.ledger_gift WHERE family_id=#{familyId}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM relations.ledger_loan WHERE family_id=#{familyId}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM relations.ledger_household_item WHERE family_id=#{familyId}), 0)

SELECT CAST(u.id AS VARCHAR) AS id,COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname),''),'家人') AS nickname FROM relations.ledger_member m JOIN relations.sys_user u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE m.family_id=#{familyId} ORDER BY u.id
SELECT * FROM relations.ledger_family WHERE hidden_owner=#{userId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE relations.ledger_family SET hidden_owner=#{userId} WHERE id=#{id}
